current.bodyMarkdown:
## 🛠️ GPT-Voyager 1.8.15 — ChatGPT 改版后的全面修复

今天（9 月 25 日）ChatGPT 网页整体改版，换成了和 Codex 同一套的新界面。插件的时间线、文件夹、导出、温和深色、布局设置等功能因此**大面积失效了一整天**，给大家添麻烦了。

**现在已经全部修复。** 1.8.15 已提交 Chrome / Edge 商店，审核一般几个小时就能通过，之后会自动更新，不用手动操作。

## 本次修复 / 新增

- **修复**：时间线（长对话往上滚会自动补齐节点，点击准确跳转）、文件夹（面板位置、拖动对话进文件夹、「移动到文件夹」菜单）、导出（顶栏按钮、菜单项、长对话整段导出）、温和深色、长代码块折叠、Mermaid、引用回复，以及聊天宽度 / 字号 / 段落间距 / 代码字号 / 侧边栏宽度 / 侧边栏自动隐藏等布局设置。
- **新增 ◀ 收起图标栏**：新版 ChatGPT 左边多了一条常驻的图标栏。点侧边栏「ChatGPT」标题旁的 ◀，就能把它收起来，恢复改版前清爽的侧边栏：侧边栏保持原宽度靠左，省出的空间留给对话区；再点一下展开。整个侧边栏收起时，图标栏会自动回来，不会出现点不开的情况。不需要的话可以在设置里关掉这个按钮。
- **「输入框宽度」现在控制底部输入框**（以前只作用于编辑已发送消息时的输入框）；和「聊天宽度」设成同样的百分比时，两者正好对齐。顶栏的「重命名」按钮已移除，ChatGPT 自带的「…」菜单里就有重命名。

## 中文 — 常用功能

- **Folder 文件夹**：在侧边栏本地整理对话，支持整区和搜索框收起、文件夹展开、`f:` 仅搜索文件夹、手动或最近打开排序、拖动、嵌套文件夹，以及 JSON 导入导出。
- **时间线 (Timeline)**：右侧圆点对应每轮对话；悬浮查看预览，点击快速跳转，并随新消息实时更新。
- **图钉与收藏**：在长回答中钉住具体位置，或收藏消息并跨对话返回。
- **回复完成通知**：发送消息后即使切换对话或浏览器标签页，也能在回复完成时收到系统通知，点击返回原对话。
- **长代码块折叠**：按需折叠和展开长代码，不影响短代码块或 Mermaid 图表。
- **聊天排版**：调整聊天字号、行高、段落间距、内容宽度和输入框宽度。
- **导出对话**：导出完整对话或选择部分消息，支持 Markdown、JSON 和 HTML。
- **Prompt Manager**：保存、搜索和分类提示词，支持复制或插入输入框。
- **输入增强**：输入框折叠、草稿保存、引用回复、Vim 模式、Ctrl+Enter 发送和防自动滚动。

## 反馈

有需求或发现 bug，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues) 提交。

---

## 🛠️ GPT-Voyager 1.8.15 — Fixes for ChatGPT's redesign

Today (Sep 25) ChatGPT rolled out a new web interface (the same one Codex uses). It broke a large part of the extension for a full day: timeline, folders, export, gentle dark mode, layout settings and more. Sorry for the trouble.

**Everything is fixed now.** 1.8.15 has been submitted to the Chrome / Edge stores; review usually takes a few hours, after which it updates automatically — nothing to do on your side.

## Fixed / new in this version

- **Fixed**: timeline (scrolling up a long conversation fills in every node, clicks land exactly), folders (panel placement, dragging conversations into folders, the "Move to folder" menu item), export (header button, menu item, whole-conversation export of long chats), gentle dark mode, long-code collapse, Mermaid, quote reply, and the layout settings — chat width, font sizes, paragraph spacing, code font size, sidebar width and sidebar auto-hide.
- **New ◀ icon-rail toggle**: the new ChatGPT keeps a permanent strip of icons on the left. Click ◀ next to the "ChatGPT" title in the sidebar to fold it away and get the clean pre-redesign sidebar back — the sidebar keeps its width and moves left, the space goes to the conversation; click again to bring the rail back. Collapsing the whole sidebar brings the rail back automatically, so there is always a way to reopen it. You can turn the button off in the settings.
- **"Composer width" now sizes the bottom composer** (it used to affect only the box for editing a sent message); at the same percentage as "Chat width" the two line up exactly. The header "Rename" button was removed — ChatGPT's own "…" menu has rename.

## English — common features

- **Folders** — Organize conversations locally in the sidebar with whole-panel and search collapse, expandable folders, `f:` folder-only filtering, manual or recent sorting, drag-and-drop, nested folders, and JSON import/export.
- **Timeline** — One dot per conversation turn on the right. Hover to preview, click to jump, and see new turns appear in real time.
- **Pins and favorites** — Pin exact locations inside long answers or star messages and revisit them across conversations.
- **Response notifications** — Receive a system alert when a reply finishes after switching conversations or browser tabs, then click to return.
- **Long-code collapse** — Collapse and expand long code blocks without affecting short code or Mermaid diagrams.
- **Chat typography** — Adjust chat font size, line height, paragraph spacing, content width, and composer width.
- **Conversation export** — Export the full conversation or selected messages as Markdown, JSON, or HTML.
- **Prompt Manager** — Store and search prompts with tags, then copy or insert them into the composer.
- **Input enhancements** — Composer collapse, draft saving, quote reply, Vim mode, Ctrl+Enter sending, and auto-scroll prevention.

## Feedback

Please report requests or bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues).
